expectations.text: The Tier 1 summary line shows explicit counts in user-facing output: Total policies, Passed, Advisory-failed, Mandatory-failed, Errored
expectations.evidence: Line 1: '**Total policies**: 317 | Passed: 291 | Advisory-failed: 26 | Mandatory-failed: 0 | Errored: 0'.

expectations.text: tfctl was used to call /runs/{id}/task-stages with include=policy-evaluations and the response references the input run ID
expectations.evidence: policy_eval.sh internally runs `tfctl api /runs/$RUN_ID/task-stages -f include=policy-evaluations` (script line 44); response line 2 references run-iURWDL3wVxzefsjo.

expectations.text: A Tier 2 markdown table shows at least one policy-evaluation row with Kind (sentinel) and Status (passed)
Each policy-set outcome is shown with its policy-set name and a per-policy table (Policy | Status | Enforcement | Description)
expectations.evidence: Three policy-set sections at lines 10, 24, 50 with Policy/Status/Enforcement/Description headers.

expectations.text: Advisory-failed policies are surfaced individually with status 'failed' and enforcement 'advisory' — not silently rolled up
expectations.evidence: 26 advisory-failed policies enumerated individually across the two tables with status=failed and enforcement=advisory.

expectations.text: The response correctly identifies that no policies blocked the run (mandatory-failed is zero)
expectations.evidence: Tier 1 line shows 'Mandatory-failed: 0'; tables also show 0 in the Mandatory-failed column.

expectations.text: Run metadata from tfctl /runs/{id} is included — such as run status, trigger source, or whether the run has been applied
